add_job_to_queue: add a job to the queue with a type, dataset, revision, and difficulty level
start_next_waiting_job: start the next waiting job from the queue by priority and creation date
finish_job_and_release_lock: finish a started job, delete it from the queue, and release its lock
get_zombie_jobs: get zombie jobs that have not sent heartbeats within a maximum time threshold
delete_dataset_waiting_jobs: delete all waiting jobs for a given dataset and release their locks
